name: loop-breaker-anchor-mismatch-retry
source: phase-7 Experiment B r2. An `edit` whose anchor text no longer matched, retried without re-reading until the turn budget went. These calls are schema-valid -- all 60 reach the hook -- so this loop IS reachable by a tool_call guard.

input.command:
python3 -c "
from unittest.mock import MagicMock, AsyncMock
from collections.abc import AbstractContextManager, AbstractAsyncContextManager
import inspect

def test_mock_behavior():
    m = MagicMock()
    print(f'isinstance(m, AbstractContextManager): {isinstance(m, AbstractContextManager)}')
    print(f'isinstance(m, AbstractAsyncContextManager): {isinstance(m, AbstractAsyncContextManager)}')
    print(f'isawaitable(m): {inspect.isawaitable(m)}')
    
    am = AsyncMock()
    print(f'isinstance(am, AbstractContextManager): {isinstance(am, AbstractContextManager)}')
    print(f'isinstance(am, AbstractAsyncContextManager): {isinstance(am, AbstractAsyncContextManager)}')
    print(f'isawaitable(am): {inspect.isawaitable(am)}')

test_mock_behavior()
"

python3 -c "
from contextlib import AbstractContextManager, AbstractAsyncContextManager
from unittest.mock import MagicMock, AsyncMock
import inspect

def test_mock_behavior():
    m = MagicMock()
    print(f'MagicMock - isinstance(AbstractContextManager): {isinstance(m, AbstractContextManager)}')
    print(f'MagicMock - isinstance(AbstractAsyncContextManager): {isinstance(m, AbstractAsyncContextManager)}')
    print(f'MagicMock - isawaitable: {inspect.isawaitable(m)}')
    
    am = AsyncMock()
    print(f'AsyncMock - isinstance(AbstractContextManager): {isinstance(am, AbstractContextManager)}')
    print(f'AsyncMock - isinstance(AbstractAsyncContextManager): {isinstance(am, AbstractAsyncContextManager)}')
    print(f'AsyncMock - isawaitable: {inspect.isawaitable(am)}')

test_mock_behavior()
"
